verdict.rationale: Bland documents a comprehensive public API (pathways, calls, tools, webhooks, evals, batch calls) plus SDKs, CLI, and an official MCP server, and runtime probes confirm the CLI installs and the hosted MCP endpoint is live and gated as documented, showing agentic programmatic control. Missing for 10: a formally published OpenAPI/Swagger spec (probe found 404s at standard OpenAPI paths), so machine-readable spec discoverability is unconfirmed.
